_sources_comment: Shape 3 (BestPractice spec/SOURCE_SET_PROSE_GAP.md, approved and built
2026-09-13). Until this landed, a session rooted in THIS set read this
set's own 16 occasion entries and not one of universal's 94 -- every
universal rule silently absent from every session ever run here, while
the session confidently applied the ones it could see. Declaring the
source is what lets precedent_session_practices.py render universal
into the UNTRACKED .precedent/SESSION_PRACTICES.md at session start.
NOTHING OF UNIVERSAL'S TEXT IS COMMITTED HERE, which is the whole
difference between this shape and the two the brief rejected. The
tracked AGENTS.md block still renders this set's own practices only:
build_views.sources_for_tracked_block() defers any source whose text
lives in another tree. If AGENTS.md ever GROWS after a build_views run,
that is shape 2 by accident -- stop rather than commit it.
A RELATIVE SIBLING, not '~/BestPractice'. Measured: $HOME is /root on
some containers and /home/user on others, so a ~ path names nothing
where the sets actually live. '../BestPractice' resolves against THIS
repo (precedent_source_bootstrap.sources_from_repo: the clone path is
repo_path / rel), which is where the session-start clone puts it.
No URL and no credential are declared, and none are needed: universal
is PUBLIC, and the clone takes its URL and its pinned branch from this
repo's own tools/ENGINE_MANIFEST.json source_repo/source_branch -- the
repository this set already says it vendored its engine from. The
branch is pinned deliberately; a clone with no --branch asks the remote
which branch to check out, and that is a setting nothing here can see.
_visibility_comment: Declared OUTRIGHT, and this key is why this file is safe to add at all.
build_views.repo_is_public() reads an ABSENT precedent.json as private --
no config, not a Precedent repo -- but a PRESENT one with no 'visibility'
key as PUBLIC, on the reasoning that omitting the field is how a public
repo publishes private practice text by accident. This repo is private
and was relying on the absent-file path. Adding this file for the
timezone alone would therefore have flipped it to public and silently
dropped team- and individual-level practices from the tracked loader
block and the materialized tree. Verified before and after: repo_is_public
stays False and AGENTS.md regenerates byte-identically.
_fallback_timezone_comment: The zone for stamping commits and generated dates in THIS repo when
nobody's own zone resolves -- no PRECEDENT_COMMIT_TZ, no identity.json
reachable, no TZ in the environment. It is rung 5 of the ladder in
tools/precedent_time.py: a person's zone is person-level and lives in
their identity.json, while the answer for a person this project could
not identify is the repository's to choose.
New York, not Buenos Aires. This is a TEAM set: shared by level, and the
one with more than one approver. Buenos Aires is Morgan's own zone and
belongs in his individual source, not in a set an unidentified committer
could be anyone in. Morgan, 2026-09-10: the Buenos Aires fallback is just
for him personally; a shared set defaults to New York.
THIS FILE'S HISTORY READS ODDLY AND THE REASON IS NOT THE DECISION.
An identical file landed in PR #33 and was reverted in PR #34 the same
day. That revert was PROCEDURAL, not a rejection: the instruction had
been typed into the wrong session's window, and reverting put the repo
back so the session that owned the task could author all four sets
consistently. The decision itself was never in doubt and was reached
twice independently, by two sessions, with the same value and the same
visibility guard. Do not read #34 as evidence that New York was tried
and found wrong.
APPLIED, NEVER ENFORCED, exactly as the engine-level rung below it is.
Applied, because the alternative is not 'no zone' but the container's
silent UTC, and a record stamped +0000 by somebody who is not in UTC
cannot be ordered against anyone else's. Never enforced, because
refusing somebody's commit over a zone THEY never declared blocks real
work on a value they never saw. Declaring a zone in your own
identity.json is what makes it yours and checked.
Set here rather than by editing the vendored hook (practice:
layered-practice-packs, registry-source-of-truth). Sibling declarations,
same date: precedent-team-writing, precedent-team-working-style, the
nomen-omen consuming repo (all New York), and precedent-individual
(Buenos Aires -- that set IS Morgan). practice: timestamps-carry-offset.
